# Budget Approval Policy

## 1. Purpose

This policy defines approval authority for unplanned business expenditure.

## 2. Manager Authority

Managers may approve eligible unplanned expenditure up to INR 50,000 when sufficient departmental budget is available.

## 3. Director Authority

Expenditure above INR 50,000 and up to INR 250,000 requires department-director approval.

## 4. Executive Approval

Expenditure above INR 250,000 requires approval from the relevant executive leader and Finance.

## 5. Budget Availability

Approval authority does not override budget availability, procurement requirements, or vendor-control requirements.
title: Budget Approval Policy

# Expense Reimbursement Policy

## 1. Scope

This policy covers reasonable and necessary business expenses incurred on behalf of NexaCorp Technologies.

## 2. Submission Deadline

Expense claims should be submitted within 30 calendar days of the transaction date.

## 3. Receipts

An itemized receipt is required for any individual expense of INR 1,500 or more.

## 4. Approval Thresholds

Claims up to INR 10,000 require the employee's manager approval.

Claims above INR 10,000 and up to INR 50,000 require department-head approval.

Claims above INR 50,000 require Finance Controller approval in addition to department-head approval.

## 5. Non-Reimbursable Expenses

# Procurement Policy

## 1. Purpose

This policy defines controls for purchasing goods and services for NexaCorp Technologies.

## 2. Purchase Requests

Business purchases above INR 25,000 require an approved purchase request before a supplier commitment is made.

## 3. Competitive Quotations

Purchases above INR 100,000 normally require at least three competitive quotations unless Strategic Procurement approves a documented exception.

## 4. Purchase Orders

A purchase order is required for supplier commitments above INR 50,000 unless the purchase belongs to an approved exempt category.

## 5. Conflict of Interest

# Business Travel Policy

## 1. Purpose

This policy establishes requirements for approved NexaCorp business travel.

## 2. Approval

Domestic business travel requires manager approval before booking.

International business travel requires approval from both the employee's manager and department director.

## 3. Booking

Employees should use NexaCorp's approved travel channel when available. Economy class is the standard for flights under six hours.

## 4. Expenses

Reasonable business travel expenses may be reimbursed when they comply with Finance Policy FIN-001.

## 5. Personal Extensions

# Employee Handbook

## 1. Purpose

This handbook provides baseline employment guidance for NexaCorp Technologies employees. Where a dedicated policy exists, the dedicated policy takes precedence over this handbook.

## 2. Working Hours

The standard workweek is 40 hours, Monday through Friday. Teams may use flexible schedules with manager approval while maintaining required customer and operational coverage.

## 3. Annual Leave

Full-time employees receive 20 working days of annual leave per calendar year. Leave requests should normally be submitted through the HR system before the planned absence.

# Leave Policy

## 1. Scope

This policy applies to full-time NexaCorp Technologies employees unless a local employment requirement provides greater benefits.

## 2. Annual Leave

Full-time employees receive 20 working days of annual leave per calendar year.

Employees should submit planned leave at least five working days in advance when reasonably possible. Manager approval is required before planned leave begins.

## 3. Carry Forward

Up to five unused annual-leave days may be carried into the following calendar year. Carried leave should be used by March 31 unless People Operations approves an exception.

## 4. Sick Leave
title: Leave Policy

text:

## 4. Sick Leave

Employees receive 10 working days of paid sick leave per calendar year. Medical documentation may be requested for an absence exceeding three consecutive working days.

## 5. Parental Leave

Eligible primary caregivers may receive up to 26 weeks of paid parental leave. Eligible secondary caregivers may receive up to four weeks of paid parental leave, subject to applicable local requirements.

## 6. Exceptions

Policy exceptions require written approval from People Operations.
title: Leave Policy

# Remote Work Policy

## 1. Purpose

The remote-work program supports flexible working while preserving collaboration, security, and customer coverage.

## 2. Standard Eligibility

Employees who have completed 90 days of employment and whose roles are designated hybrid-eligible may request remote work.

## 3. Remote Work Limit

Eligible employees may work remotely for up to three days per workweek.

The employee's manager must approve the recurring remote-work schedule.

## 4. Office Requirements

Teams may designate collaboration days when in-person attendance is required. Business-critical meetings may override a normal remote-work day.

# IT Incident Reporting Procedure

## 1. Scope

This procedure covers operational IT incidents such as service outages, device failures, and application-access problems.

## 2. Reporting

Employees should report operational IT incidents through the IT Service Desk.

## 3. Critical Incidents

A widespread outage affecting a business-critical service should be marked as critical and escalated to the on-call IT operations lead.

## 4. Security Incidents

Suspected phishing, credential theft, malware, or unauthorized data access must follow the Information Security Policy SEC-001 rather than only the standard IT incident process.

## 5. Incident Information

# Software Access Policy

## 1. Purpose

This policy governs access to company-managed software and SaaS applications.

## 2. Access Principle

Access is granted according to job responsibilities and the principle of least privilege.

## 3. Approval

Standard applications may be approved by the employee's manager. Privileged or administrative access requires approval from the system owner.

## 4. Review

Privileged access is reviewed at least quarterly.

## 5. Termination

Access must be removed when it is no longer required and must be revoked promptly following employment termination.
title: Software Access Policy

# VPN Access Guide

## 1. Purpose

NexaCorp's VPN provides secure remote access to approved internal services.

## 2. Requirements

VPN access requires a company-managed device, an active corporate account, and multi-factor authentication.

## 3. Connection

Employees should launch the approved NexaCorp VPN client, authenticate with their corporate account, and complete the multi-factor authentication challenge.

## 4. Access Problems

Users should first confirm internet connectivity and retry authentication. Repeated failures should be reported to the IT Service Desk.

## 5. Security

Employees must not share VPN credentials or approve an unexpected multi-factor authentication request.
title: VPN Access Guide

# Vendor Management Policy

## 1. Purpose

This policy establishes minimum controls for onboarding and managing third-party vendors.

## 2. Due Diligence

New vendors must complete business due diligence before onboarding.

Vendors that will access Confidential or Restricted information also require an information-security review.

## 3. Contract Approval

Contracts must be reviewed through the approved contracting process before signature.

## 4. Performance Review

Critical vendors are reviewed at least annually for performance, risk, and continuing business need.

## 5. Procurement

Purchasing activity must also comply with Procurement Policy FIN-002.

# Enterprise Service SLA

## 1. Purpose

This document defines internal service targets for NexaCorp's Enterprise platform.

## 2. Priority 1

A Priority 1 incident represents a complete production outage or critical loss of service for a significant customer population.

The target initial response time for Priority 1 incidents is 15 minutes.

## 3. Priority 2

A Priority 2 incident represents substantial degradation with a viable workaround unavailable or severely limited.

The target initial response time for Priority 2 incidents is one hour.

## 4. Priority 3

A Priority 3 incident represents limited impact or a non-critical defect.

# Acceptable Use Policy

## 1. Purpose

Company technology resources are provided primarily for authorized business activities.

## 2. Prohibited Activities

Employees must not intentionally bypass security controls, install unauthorized software, share credentials, or use company systems for unlawful activity.

## 3. Limited Personal Use

Limited personal use is permitted when it does not interfere with work, create material cost, or violate company policy.

## 4. Monitoring

Company systems may be logged and monitored in accordance with applicable law and NexaCorp policy.

## 5. Reporting

Suspected misuse or security concerns should be reported through approved IT or Security channels.
title: Acceptable Use Policy

# Data Classification Policy

## 1. Purpose

NexaCorp classifies information according to its sensitivity and required handling controls.

## 2. Public

Public information is approved for unrestricted external distribution.

## 3. Internal

Internal information is intended for NexaCorp employees and authorized partners and should not be publicly distributed without approval.

## 4. Confidential

Confidential information includes sensitive business, customer, financial, and employee information. Access is limited to authorized users with a business need.

## 5. Restricted

## 1. Purpose

This policy establishes baseline information-security requirements for NexaCorp Technologies.

## 2. Authentication

Multi-factor authentication is required for remote access and for systems classified as business critical.

## 3. Security Incident Reporting

Suspected phishing, credential compromise, malware, or unauthorized access must be reported to the Security Operations team immediately through the approved security-incident channel.

## 4. Company Devices

Restricted information should be accessed only from approved company-managed devices unless Information Security has authorized an exception.
